fusions.name: Weighted Hem
fusions.desc: Snaps a weighted hem at the first enemy in front of you for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unpick the Seams
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 15 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Bandage
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Wrapped Tight
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
